data.name: Quick Trapsmith
data.description: As a full-round action, an investigator with this talent can set a simple trap with a CR no greater than 1/2 her investigator level. To do this, she must purchase the components, spend the required time constructing the trap in advance, and have its components at hand. The type of trap that can be constructed in this way is subject to GM discretion.
